study.question: Does inverse-norm-rank reflection outperform a temporal-order reflection with identical scale multisets and identical reversal cycle structure? Observation: latest aligned rank-half AUC/Logloss are 0.6151021885074872/0.19653258393542125 versus native full 0.6149816911798147/0.19656340759133067. Half rotates sorted eligible inverse norms by floor(n/2), rather than multiplying by 0.5. Crossed products also benefit; mean/adjacent replacements are competitive. Thus useful scale-to-event assignment versus generic reassignment remains unresolved. This bounded attribution comparison is permitted now; cross-seed robustness remains the higher-priority unanswered question but train_seed=42 cannot be overridden. Original memory://agent-r0012 was inspected: the chronological-versus-rank by adjacent-versus-half AUC interaction is -0.0003459909, and sampled rank-half donor correlation is negative. That counterexample already weakens a necessary-locality/positive-correlation story; it does not establish a monotonic anti-correlation mechanism. Reflection tests this stronger explanation with a matched cycle-structure control rather than selecting another rotation offset.
study.hypothesis: Generic inverse-norm redistribution may help optimization by breaking each event's native inverse-norm coupling. A stronger, specific version predicts that an antitone assignment (sorted donor rank n-1-r) helps more than reversal in supplied temporal order because the rank rule systematically exchanges extreme scales. Both preserve every eligible scale and the tangent projector at a fixed model state. This is a provisional optimization hypothesis, not semantic mediation or a verified novelty claim.

README confirms this dataset has category, brand and behavior type without history item IDs. No invented item sequence, user-item matching objective or DMR paper reproduction; publisher full text is unavailable.

Immediate parent. Retain its parameter construction, aligned unit forward, half-style detached coefficient transport, BCE and no-row training path. Replace sorted half rotation with sorted reflection or temporal reflection. No fresh initialization robustness claim.

Historical receipts establish competitive donor/mean replacements, not a unique semantic interpretation. Reflection differs from cyclic shifts: it has floor(n/2) transpositions and n mod 2 fixed points. Temporal reflection matches that cycle structure, unlike the half-rotation parent. Original source modules for these older arms are unavailable; current ancestor code supplies the half helper. Full original memory://agent-r0012 observations, alternatives and limitations were read; its negative sampled scale correlation motivates testing, not accepting, the stronger antitone hypothesis. Temporal donor age/behavior statistics remain unmatched.
External parallel field/sequence buses and FM Highway change forward representation and training. No such architecture is adopted; a direct-readout bottleneck is unestablished locally.
External attention-generated probes and packed multiple views concern a different task. No local query-generation bottleneck is established and no probe/view mechanism is introduced.

study.proposed_difference: Two common-source standalone variants: rank_reflection (candidate) assigns inverse norms by reversed sorted rank; temporal_reflection (control) assigns them by reversed supplied valid-event order. Only valid events with squared product norm>=1e-6 are eligible; masked/floored events retain native derivatives and never donate. Stable position breaks ties. For regular events J_i=a_donor*(I-u_i u_i^T), with all scale/donor derivatives stopped. Reflection is an involutive permutation; n=0/1 is unchanged. Existing rank-half and full receipts are secondary historical anchors, not new independent repetitions. This is a mechanism-distinct replacement of the local backward mapping, not a newly claimed architecture. Primary search normalization/gradient/permutation/rearrangement/conditioning returned no registered paper matches; that is bounded retrieval failure, not evidence of priority.
predictions: At a common state all three mappings have the same forward logits. Both reflection variants preserve the full eligible inverse-scale multiset, all its moments, reversal cycle structure and parameter count; neither preserves the actual upstream-weighted gradient energy, shared-row gradient sums or Adam updates.

The rank-specific hypothesis predicts rank_reflection AUC > temporal_reflection and lower Logloss under the frozen recipe; agreement on both strengthens local performance support. Opposing metrics or tiny differences remain mixed, without invented significance thresholds.

Candidate-supplied same-checkpoint diagnostics should show zero donor-oracle mismatch, unchanged invalid donors, multiset conservation and small analytical VJP discrepancy, including empty/singleton/odd/even histories, ties, floors, boundary and nonprefix masks. Scaled VJP errors above5e-5 f32 or1e-10 f64, or nonfinite outputs, make derivative attribution unresolved.

Report all four host history bins (empty,1-16,17-64,>64) plus available hour/composition/frequency slices with sample/positive/negative counts. Short-history regressions remain visible; no slice threshold will be retuned. The first512 input-only diagnostics are not population estimates.

Use current r0034-closure_half as the operational anchor. A rank-reflection gain over it can motivate later authorized paired-seed assessment; reversal-control superiority or a null also supplies an admissible result. No performance is claimed before host execution.
falsifiers: Rank_reflection failing to beat temporal_reflection on population AUC weakens the rank-specific performance hypothesis for this implementation/seed. If both trail the established rank-half anchor, retain that anchor and reject replacement for now; do not universally refute redistribution.

Different forward values at a common state, changed marginal scale multisets, padding/floor donor contamination, incorrect selected-rule VJP or parameter-count mismatch defeats the intended controlled contrast irrespective of score.
Both reflection variants beating native full but matching each other favors generic redistribution or shared cycle structure over rank-specific assignment, without establishing causal mediation.

Any unavailable runtime, resource admission failure or charged training failure is a feasibility/execution outcome, not a negative scientific result. No independent seeds or user-cluster intervals are supplied; reproducibility/significance/novelty remain unestablished.
alternative_explanations: Generic conditioning or implicit regularization, rather than systematic inverse-scale anti-coupling.
Temporal order correlates with product norms/age/behavior, so temporal reflection is not a semantic null; rank reflection also changes donor distance and actual gradient energy.
Stable tie handling and odd-length fixed points affect realized replacement strength. Matching reversal cycle structure does not equal matching per-event upstream gradients or shared-row updates.
Shared category/brand tables couple product, query, static and value paths and even alter empty-history predictions after retraining.
Single seed42, adaptive reuse of validation and best-checkpoint selection can favor small effects. Additional seeds would not erase historical selection bias.

Historical magnitude maximum did not replay from exact source/config, later magnitude contrasts have both signs, and four trace-v1 jobs were execution failures. These are preserved reasons to exclude magnitude surgery from this comparison.
